items.hed: Rockets visit the Suns Saturday night
items.insight: NBA.com's Rockets page says the next chance for the injured veteran big man to return is Saturday, when Houston visits Phoenix. The league schedule lists that game as Saturday, Nov. 7, Houston at Phoenix, 9:00 p.m. Eastern. Wednesday's game at Toyota Center is already final on the same schedule.

items.hed: Texans named Woody Marks their 2026 Salute to Service nominee
items.insight: The club said Thursday that running back Woody Marks is Houston's nominee for the award, which recognizes players, coaches, staff, and alumni who support service members, veterans, and their families. Marks hosted a free two-day football camp for military children at Fort Hood in July, and in 2025 he was a guest coach in the club's Salute to Service Showdown. Houston's gameday page still has Sunday, Nov. 8, at SoFi Stadium against the Chargers, 3:05 p.m. Central.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium interior. Ed Schipul, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0.

items.hed: Astros exercised Isaac Paredes's 2027 option on Nov. 2
items.insight: MLB.com's Astros injuries and roster page, dated Nov. 2, lists the Nov. 2 moves as the team option on third baseman Isaac Paredes for 2027, Roddery Muñoz selected to the 40-man roster, Evan Reifert acquired from Tampa Bay for cash and added to the 40-man, and catcher César Salazar selected to the 40-man. The same page still has outfielder Joey Loperfido out for 2027 after late-October right-hip surgery.
